recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future mADX/public-health quality-reporting changes should be handled under their own CQI or IG-specific trackers, especially if they propose changing the current component-level stratifier value-set model or adding a new MeasureReport classification element.
issue_request: FHIR-14098 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked CQI to extend Measure and MeasureReport for public health and health-system indicator reporting by generalizing patient-centric narrative, adding codes to correlate measurements, allowing coded/constrained stratifier values, and adding a secondary MeasureReport classification. The resolution said the requested changes were applied through other tracker items except the proposed MeasureReport.code, which could be handled with useContext or topic.
initial_application: No direct git commit mentioning FHIR-14098 was found. Jira says the work was applied through other tracker items. The clearest historical application is git/SVN commit 734c7befc75fc6677ab2dbae8d77bdc07428cc5b, which applied GF#14057, GF#14060, and GF#14083 together by generalizing Measure/MeasureReport from patient to subject, replacing correlation identifiers with code elements, and making MeasureReport stratifier values CodeableConcept. Later related work added public-health examples and stratifier value-set support.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active current-build resources. Current Measure defines useContext, group.code, stratifier.code, stratifier.component.code, and stratifier.component.valueSet; current MeasureReport defines group.code, group.stratifier.code, and group.stratifier.stratum.value[x] including CodeableConcept. Current narrative covers public health indicators, population analytics measures, subject/group reports, summary reports, and data-exchange reports. Later FHIR-53139 intentionally refined value-set support to component-level value-based stratifiers, and later FHIR-55436 removed explicit Measure.topic while leaving Measure.useContext available for the classification use case.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was needed because current active source already preserves the accepted behavior, and adding MeasureReport.code, restoring a top-level stratifier valueSet/codeConstraint, or duplicating narrative would conflict with later decisions or add redundant guidance.

related_jiras.note: Generalized MeasureReport/Measure from patient-only to subject-based semantics and was applied in the same SVN/git commit that implemented several FHIR-14098 prerequisites.
Replaced Measure and MeasureReport correlation identifiers with code elements for population/public-health reporting use cases.
Changed MeasureReport stratifier values to CodeableConcept, matching the seed request for coded stratifier values.
Added the public-health Measure/MeasureReport example and is already represented on the combined branch by a separate audit commit.

Added Measure stratifier/component/supplementalData valueSet and unit support for reporting/disaggregation levels and is already represented on the combined branch by a separate reconciliation commit.
Refined FHIR-20723 by making value-based stratifier valueSet guidance component-level rather than top-level.
Updated current Measure and MeasureReport Scope and Usage summaries, preserving public-health and population-analytics wording.
Removed explicit Measure.topic while leaving Measure.useContext available for the classification use case cited in the seed resolution.
